title: Possessory support
getting_started: Create a household, choose its currency and add rooms. Add a belonging with its purchase details and optional warranty expiry date. No account is required.
where_is_my_data: Inventory records and attachments are stored in the app’s private storage on this device. Nothing is silently synchronised. Uninstalling removes local data, so save and verify a backup first.
receipts: Attach a receipt image or PDF, choose a page and receipt language, and use the review crop controls or rotation before on-device text extraction. Check every suggestion before applying it. The complete original attachment is retained. Currency changes are never inferred silently.
backup: In Settings, save a ZIP backup with metadata and attachments. Optionally choose password protection and use at least twelve characters. Keep the password securely: it cannot be recovered. The restore size limit is 100 MiB decompressed; individual attachment imports are limited to 25 MiB. Backup metadata is limited to 8 MiB; attachments are staged in private cache during restore to limit memory use.
restore: Open a backup in Settings, enter its password if encrypted and inspect the import preview. Possessory checks the schema, attachment hashes and record references. Existing record IDs are retained and only new records are merged. Verify your belongings and attachments after restoring.
reminders: Enable optional reminders in Settings and allow notifications when prompted. Possessory checks upcoming warranty dates and scheduled maintenance approximately daily. Device power management can delay notifications. Reminders do not replace professional safety inspections.
voice: Use the command phrases shown in the app, then review the transcript. Supported actions include navigation, finding belongings, room counts, creating an item draft, reading warranty reminders and moving one uniquely identified item after confirmation. Expanded actions require Premium. Type a command when device speech recognition is unavailable; the speech provider may use a network service.
reports: Choose a room, category or currency-specific value filter and an output format. Review serial-number, recorded-value, photo and document-reference settings before saving. Browse the paginated summary or open the PDF preview. Reports are user-maintained inventory records and are not insurer-certified valuations.
premium: Premium is a one-time Amazon purchase with no subscription. The store supplies the local price. Purchase and restore require internet access. Amazon user and purchase-receipt identifiers are sent over HTTPS to the Possessory verifier hosted on Cloudflare Workers, which checks Amazon and returns a signed entitlement. Household inventory and photographed receipts are not sent. The verifier uses connection IP addresses and hashed purchase identifiers for short-lived rate limiting, has no customer database and disables application request logging. Cloudflare processes network metadata to operate and secure its service. Offline signed access lasts up to 90 days, or until an earlier verified cancellation takes effect, before it needs refreshing. Existing records, ordinary editing, deletion and backup restore remain available without Premium.
warranties: Warranty dates and terms are supplied by you. Manufacturer warranties and statutory consumer rights are separate. Possessory does not determine eligibility or provide definitive legal advice.
delete: Delete a belonging from its detail screen to remove its record, attachments and maintenance entries. To remove every local record and setting, use Delete all local data in Settings and confirm. Files you exported elsewhere are not deleted.
draft_notice: Engineering preview support draft. Device-specific validation and translation review are pending.
app_lock: Enable device-unlock protection in Settings after setting a device PIN, pattern or password. Possessory uses the system credential screen and does not store that credential. Locking hides recent-app previews and screenshots. This is separate from at-rest encryption.
